title: Monolithic versus Staggered Magnetomechanical Relaxation
exact_target: Decide when combined and successive relaxations give the same effective magnetomechanical model.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004442 (OWR-17476-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mechanics of Materials: Towards Predictive Methods for Kinetics in Plasticity, Fracture, and Damage (2020), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2020/13, pp. 713--783. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 27.
Rossi--Thomas (2017) (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Crismale--Lazzaroni--Rossi (2023) (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The ordering, topology and compatibility constraints of the partial relaxations matter. Equality of two numerical minimization runs does not establish equivalence of the variational relaxation procedures.
